set.body: Follow-up to bd-01M4EMEBCBMBHA7BF4BQY6AFPB (closed 2026-10-10 in scope). The frozen voxelwise FGLS candidate (ContinuousMissing censor continuity + AcrossRuns voxel AR scope + Kenward-Roger) fails when AR(2) parameters differ between runs within a voxel: AR RMSE 0.135 vs 0.10 margin and whiteness failure (docs/verification/fgls-voxelwise-20261010/). Per-run voxelwise estimation has a theoretical RMSE floor of 0.092-0.096 at short run lengths, so a different estimator is needed (e.g. hierarchical/shrinkage of run AR toward the voxel AR, or spatial pooling across neighbouring voxels). Declare a new development/confirmation protocol; original margins stay binding.
set.title: Voxelwise FGLS: run-varying AR within a voxel
